title: Compose two causal helper splits with the fixed quotient graph
body:
The two literal causal split witnesses at charts 498 and 595 from [PR #7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712) compose with all 33 restrictions in the frozen [PR #7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) graph. The construction has 1,470 independent public fields, all 400 mains and 1,070 helper returns. Every one of the 6,054 paid keys and ordered chart routes is unchanged. This resolves a specific compatibility request; **no new kappa or physical supplier admission is claimed**. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491/research/quotient-causal-split-composition/PROOF.md) · [Exact receipt and expanded witnesses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491/research/quotient-causal-split-composition/RESULT.json) · [Constructive checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491/research/quotient-causal-split-composition/verify.py) · [Input pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491/research/quotient-causal-split-composition/SOURCE-PINS.json) · [Credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1636b3c9b922d23b222b60dd52e005e60c592491/research/quotient-causal-split-composition/CREDITS.md)

Original helper 126 remains compact role 126 and splits rank nine into four and five. Original helper 281 is compact role 278 and splits rank nine into one and eight. The new independent entrances are 1468 and 1469. Exact prefix/readout and departure/response pairings are one at both cuts. The second cut is evaluated on the actual first composition. The source chart-480 split is excluded because role 239 and banks 92659/93428 were removed; that known collision is not a new result. [Original split identity](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5001d95a5c1decfb2b0d64d13c130300797e722a/research/p104-banked-cf6a-splits/PROOF.md) · [Published split circuit](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5001d95a5c1decfb2b0d64d13c130300797e722a/research/p104-banked-cf6a-splits/data/CIRCUIT.json.gz)

| Complete 16-call invoice | Compact parent | Composition |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid jobs | 100416 | 100416 |
| Productive jobs | 20624 | 20656 |
| Paid rank mass | 268368 | 268368 |
| Productive rank mass | 269696 | 269696 |

Both lost rank-nine targets are debited. The surplus stays 1,328. For every `0<t<1`, the signed productive-minus-paid power margin increases by `16*(4^t+5^t+1^t+8^t-2*9^t)>0`. This uses the unchanged published fixed caller and root rows; it does not prove their admission or a numerical kappa crossing. Local scalar terms rise from 175,927 to 178,845 per call, an increase of 2,918. Physical scalar/grid/range, owned-home/reset, phase and compiler costs remain obligations and are not assigned zero.

The full 1,469-row first composition uses 9,758,827 exact coefficient products. The final 1,470-row evaluation uses 9,966,426; a transposed traversal uses 8,111,567. Every helper returns its own independent input, and every main equals the compact parent. Positive controls check both literal witnesses on the unsplit parent. Four constructed faulty circuits expose omitted prefix subtraction or exit decoding, with exact one-input witnesses; an undecremented target bill is rejected. The reconstructed graph SHA-256 is `5183479ecac34a1cb5c046f202e19d7161679265fe121b4a0af922fe344d8fc1`.

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/quotient-causal-split-composition
```

Both registered normal and optimized commands print:

```text
PASS_QUOTIENT_CAUSAL_SPLIT_COMPOSITION 1470 6054 1070
```

Normal/optimized local replay, retained source-byte checks, committed bytes/modes, source history, committed export and sealed Git-free optimized replay pass. Hosted CI is pending; it is not scientific evidence yet.

The normalized input is a source-constructor export, hash `16e99893a2c669467ce74f214e8eb5150402f0267aaa8d67aad5d870aa4d5c18`, separately checked in [PR #7715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7715). Its [basis engine](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/verify.py) is reused byte for byte. The source proof and code were read. This is author checking, not blind, independent human or formal-kernel review. Raw source reconstruction, full physical/native and compiler replay, source numerical crossing, complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five inherited interfaces remain open.

Base is refreshed canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Task `p104-side-correction` is refined to two fixed source witnesses. The split source is `5001d95a5c1decfb2b0d64d13c130300797e722a`; the quotient scientific source is `06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b`, published head `52e7eb424b9ae9f2e6002eb17e475bce6195d848`; the basis source is `4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9`. Fresh PR/Discussion overlap, source-reference intake and the unchanged closed-cache delta were checked. This freezes the source and adds helper returns; it does not take the live joint helper-removal search or change its paid banks. Sparse local and unpublished work remain limits. [Compatibility request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19711980) · [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19712390)

All supplier notices and retained input bytes are preserved. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

A future implementation check must price the actual scalar grid and ranges, owned homes and resets, and signed phase/compound compiler interfaces for this exact graph. No follow-up is reserved and the selected frontier is unchanged.
